# 🧬 BioProc AI Assistant

AI-powered downstream bioprocessing assistant for DSP scientists.

## Features

- AI DSP Chatbot
- PDF SOP Analyzer (RAG)
- DSP Troubleshooting Expert
- DSP Engineering Calculators
- Chromatogram Analysis
- Chromatogram Comparison
- AI Pooling Recommendation

---

## Technologies Used

- Python
- Streamlit
- Ollama
- LangChain
- ChromaDB
- HuggingFace Embeddings
- Pandas
- Matplotlib
- SciPy

---

## Installation

### Clone Repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/BioProc_AI.git
cd BioProc_AI
```

### Install Dependencies

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Run Ollama

```bash
ollama run phi3:mini
```

### Launch App

```bash
streamlit run app.py
```
